given: records written at different moments for one Organization
when: a Staff Member opens the log
then: the records come newest first and the last one written is at the top

given: records about two different subjects in one Organization
when: a Staff Member opens the log
then: both subjects' records are in the list; this is the Organization's log and not one subject's history

given: records exist for an Organization the Staff Member has no membership in
when: they ask for that Organization's log
then: nothing comes back and the answer is the same as for an Organization that does not exist

given: the Staff Member holds active memberships in two Organizations that both have records
then: only that Organization's records come back; row-level security alone would let both through, which is why the read names the Organization itself

given: an Organization has more records than the read returns
when: a Staff Member opens the log
then: the list says how many there are in all, so a capped list never reads as a complete one

given: a check-in or a Folio line was reversed with a reason
when: a Staff Member opens the log
then: the record names the actor's id and carries the reason they gave, because the two were written in the same transaction as the reversal

given: the Property's Organization has no active Subscription, or platform_core is not entitled, or `audit` is not enabled on the Property
when: a Staff Member opens the log through that Property
then: nothing comes back; the gate is evaluated in the same transaction as the read, not in the application

given: the Property belongs to another Organization or the Staff Member is not assigned to it
when: they open the log through that Property
then: nothing comes back and the answer is the same as for a Property that does not exist

situation: An action the screen has no word for
given: a module writes an action name the workspace catalogue does not know
then: the raw action name is shown, never a blank; the label is added in the same commit as the writer

given: records by the viewer and by somebody else
then: the viewer's own rows say so; everyone else is a stable id, because that is all the policies let the screen know today (PRE-01)

given: a record written at a Property whose timezone is not the reader's
then: the time is the Property's wall clock and the machine-readable instant is on the element

situation: A page reaching the module directly
given: a file outside src/server imports the platform audit module at runtime
then: the build fails on the funnel rule, which until now named the Ranza tier and not the platform one

situation: A record written while the page is open
given: a colleague reverses a charge after the list loaded
when: the reader looks at the list
then: it is not there until the page is loaded again; nothing on this screen is live (ADR 0019 is the arrivals poll and is not applied here)

given: there is no signed-in viewer
then: nothing comes back (ADR 0007)

given: any record
then: no record is changed or removed; the trigger and the revoked grants refuse it whoever asks

given: a record in the loaded list
then: the whole reason and every context fact are shown, and a Folio subject links to its Folio in Finance

situation: A record that is not in the list
given: a record id older than the cap or one somebody guessed
then: the list is shown, exactly as for a record that never existed

given: a Staff Member with access_scope assigned_properties and one assignment
then: they see every Property's records, because audit.records has no property_id and the policy is membership-wide; recorded here so a later narrowing is a deliberate change

given: public.users has no name column and users_read_self lets a Staff Member read only their own row
then: blocks: s3. A co-member lookup (a security definer function returning a colleague's display value) is a migration and is not in this feature

given: audit.records carries organization_id only
then: deferred: a property_id column is a migration and the blueprint 7.4 list names Property

given: roles are named sets of permissions (ADR 0026) and the permission gate sits in front of every write, not in front of any read
when: only some roles should open the log
then: deferred: a read is bounded by capability and reach like every list in the Workspace; a permission for opening the log is a staff_permissions catalogue row, and that is a migration

given: an Organization has more records than the cap
when: the reader wants the older ones
then: deferred: keyset pagination on (occurred_at; id) when a screen asks for it

given: the log is wanted outside the product
then: out of scope: Organization Data export is blueprint 3.6 and its own feature
